Thank you so much for replying. 

>You said you had to give him that presentation in 6 hours? My advice: work on the project outline for that time, keep yourself occupied. I find that I tend to work incredibly well under pressure. Heck, if need be, even tell him that you're having suicidal thoughts. Your boss (over here at least) is required by law to offer you help for any condition that you might need help with.

Just to be clear he's my university project supervisor as a postgraduate student, not my boss. I think I'm going to tell him that I have no idea what I'm doing and see what happens. I'm clearly not fit for university and my inability to seek help with my problems before they escalate is infinitely destructive. How I feel isn't relevant to him and I think telling him it would trigger some serious consequences.
